release_notes: v1.1.8: Reports recording only after microphone startup; drains available buffered PCM on Stop with a bounded stop fallback. Incomplete AI-polishing responses now preserve the local transcript. History adds a reprocess action that replaces the transcript only, keeps the original audio/history entry, disables experimental acoustic bias, and uses lossless non-overlapping low-energy windows for long retries. ARM64-only; updates remain manual.
